sbar.situation: The bank's payment journey has recovered after four faults in screening, clearing, ledger and gateway. Two recovery checks in a row ran clean, the last at 33 s.
sbar.background: An operator changed the gateway setting balance_cache_ttl_s from 0.5 s to 600 s shortly before the incident. At about the same time the screening primary began timing out (p95 1820 ms against a 15 ms baseline), clearing crashed on a malformed queue item 98, and the reconciliation session took a write lock on the ledger.
sbar.assessment: The incident commander took every action itself: it failed screening over to its standby, ended the reconciliation session holding the ledger lock, and reverted balance_cache_ttl_s on the gateway to 0.5 s. It also set clearing item 98 aside, which had failed with a JSONDecodeError and blocked a backlog of 38, and then restarted clearing. All five actions completed.
sbar.recommendation: The operations team must review clearing item 98 (escalated, soon) and either repair and resubmit it or close it with its customer. Find out why the screening primary timed out before failing back from the standby, and confirm the reconciliation batch reruns cleanly after its session was ended.
